item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records all 12 ids reproduced at base, 9 repaired with the commit read for each, 3 reported blocked with the production repair named, head 3 failed/76 passed at fa865aaa2, and one negative-control log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares the nine test files plus the evidence fragment and a figures directory; every path in git diff --name-status ffa922ba..fa865aaa2 (seven tests and the evidence fragment) is inside them, and the two untouched declared tests are the blocked ids.
